title: PISIGuard: Protect your personal and sensitive info when you chat with AI
summary: PISIGuard is a privacy protection tool that detects and redacts personal identifiable information (PII) before sending user messages to AI chatbots, preventing sensitive data leakage to third-party AI services.
problem_solved: Prevents accidental exposure of sensitive personal information when users interact with AI chatbots that may store or process user data.
why_valuable: In the era of widespread AI adoption, it provides a critical layer of privacy protection by automatically identifying and masking PII before it leaves the user's device.
